items.text: Malik Nabers is active for SNF vs Cowboys after murky/Q knee status and PS elevations of Berrios/Cambre.
items.why: Knee; full practice but 'up to him'; game-time
items.implication: Start with risk/reward (possible decoy); high upside if full go

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions. Status affects projections for Travis Etienne and others in NO backfield.
items.why: MCL sprain; full participant late week but not ready per reports
items.implication: Etienne unchallenged lead back; elevated snap/carry share
items.opportunity: Etienne primary carries/routes/RZ; Kendre Miller RB2

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Flowers (hamstring), McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), others including Lane/Cooper. Combine with Bowers/AJ Brown/Darnold/Stribling.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2; Flowers big day then out

items.text: Risk reward because maybe decoy but starting Malik Nabers wherever owned after active confirmation.
items.why: Active despite prior uncertainty and PS elevations
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 in most formats with ceiling

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: Reduced BAL WR depth; Flowers/others more volume pre his exit

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cardinals wouldn't activate if worried about ankle. Confirmed expected then active.
items.why: Ankle sprain; progressive positive reports and expected to play
items.implication: Viable RB2/flex with upside despite Allgeier presence and risk
items.opportunity: Potential early-down/goal-line role expansion if healthy

items.text: Love is risk/reward RB2 but starting him everywhere owned; wouldn't activate if injury concern (though Cardinals).
Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.implication: Multi-week absence; NE WR depth elevated
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining NE pass-catchers

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active today vs Panthers after expected to play with calf injury.
items.why: Calf; self-reported ready, limited practice but cleared
items.implication: Startable WR with Bears offense volume; monitor snap share

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers; OUT Week 1.
items.implication: Short absence possible; Mayer primary TE beneficiary short-term

items.text: Main slate news largely locked; Nabers (Q knee) murky/up-to-him for SNF with PS elevations of Berrios and Cambre. Projections live/no major other changes.
items.why: Sounds up to player; elevated PS WRs signal caution
items.implication: Hold projections flexible; high variance if limited

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love/Odunze expected to play; Kamara not; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet (later active).
items.implication: Main slate mostly locked; monitor SNF Nabers and inactives

items.text: Combine watching list with Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Sam Darnold (hip), De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle). Not a clean start for injuries.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason wanted as much Bears offense as possible and that hasn't changed despite Week 1 target questions.
items.why: Preseason strong on Bears pass-catchers; Week 1 weirdness not structural
items.implication: Hold/buy for TE upside in CHI offense

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk; coming from Packers with new OC Sean Mannion.
items.implication: Viable depth/flex in PHI; monitor role

items.text: Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive today (back) amid contract dispute; trade possibility remains.
